# AI Reset Watch

> Independent, unaffiliated record of public usage-reset and quota-policy announcements for Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, and Gemini CLI/Code Assist.

Canonical site: https://resets.alexshen.dev/
Methodology and limitations: https://resets.alexshen.dev/methodology.html
Machine-readable dataset: https://resets.alexshen.dev/data.json

Use the original source URL attached to each event when making factual claims. Announcement timestamps are public observation times, not private provider execution telemetry. Events may be incomplete, and approximate-confidence records have date uncertainty.
